articles.title: British homebuilder shares slump on lack of clarity over first-time buyer plan in budget
articles.content: Shares of British homebuilders plummeted following finance minister John Healey's budget speech about housing initiatives. The delays surrounding the launch and funding of the awaited 'Your First Home' scheme have analysts worried that it won’t receive long-term financial support. Prominent companies like Barratt Redrow, Taylor Wimpey, and Persimmon experienced sharp declines, which could further hinder the timeline for new site developments that builders are eager to pursue.

articles.title: Sebi to review FPI compliance norms, issue consultation paper to align with global standards
articles.content: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated they will review compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors in India. This initiative aims to enhance foreign investor participation in domestic markets and streamline access procedures. Additionally, Pandey emphasized the significance of domestic savings along with international capital to support market development.

articles.title: India bonds end flat as oil woes come up against short covering
articles.content: Indian government bonds faced volatility as oil price hikes raised inflation concerns and affected market sentiment. The 6.94% 2036 bond yield fluctuated but ended slightly unchanged as traders reacted to market conditions. Elevated crude prices have increased worries about inflation, a wider fiscal deficit, and slower economic growth for India. The rupee weakened further against the dollar, prompting fears of aggressive policy tightening by the Reserve Bank of India.
